_notes: Map correspondent names (as they appear in trust_urls.json / icb_urls.json) to email addresses. Names without an email get logged but no alert is sent. 'TBC' is used in the org files for unassigned orgs and is intentionally absent from this map.
_operators_notes: People who RUN the sweep, as opposed to correspondents who receive alerts for their patch. Step 13B emails the run report (including the scan-health block) to whoever ran it. Resolve from --operator, else `git config user.email`, else ASK - never guess an address. A git identity that is not listed here must be confirmed with the user before a live send.
